column1: # Language guard 2 exemptions: Chinese text in a src/main/java literal that is deliberately not routed
# through the language catalogue. One line per literal, three tab-separated fields:
#   path (relative to the module root) <TAB> the literal exactly as written between its quotes <TAB> reason
# Every line needs a reason. A line that no longer matches a literal fails the build (UltiSideBarCjkLiteralScopeTest).

column3: A line of every lines list an earlier version shipped (SHIPPED_LINES_FIRST, _SECOND, SHIPPED_LINES). An earlier version's shipped default, compared byte for byte to recognise an operator file nobody edited (maintainer decision 2026-09-25; UltiKits/UltiSideBar#24). It is also part of the Java default the framework writes for a missing key; materializeText then replaces the whole list with the language file's sidebar_default_lines in the server's language (whose zh text is these same bytes), so no text reaches a player from this literal that the language file does not also hold
